_why: Files drawer honesty, before/after deck (2026-09-11). Every state is a workbench-only override of window.claude.artifacts.*; nothing real is touched. The same plan runs on master and on the branch — master simply renders the old wording — so both sweeps verify and the deck compares the pictures.

pre.eval: if(new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('mode')!=='workbench'||!new URLSearchParams(location.search).has('child')) throw new Error('Mock injection requires child workbench'); /* Mock namespaces are get-only catch-all proxies, so assigning one method is dropped — wrap each with a local override map (pattern from plans/error-batch1.json). */ for(const ns of ['artifacts','session']){const original=window.claude[ns], overrides={};window.claude[ns]=new Proxy(original,{get:(t,k)=>Object.hasOwn(overrides,k)?overrides[k]:Reflect.get(t,k),set:(_t,k,v)=>{overrides[k]=v;return true;}});} window.seen=(...parts)=>parts.some(p=>document.body.innerText.includes(p));
